highlights: DEV-074 review: BinaryEditorHostManager no longer drains pending on did-finish-load; renderer must ack via binary:host:ready (senderId = webContents.id). roundTrip waits up to 1500ms for ack; missing __nexnoteHostFlush now throws rather than silently succeeding. close() captures entry identity + webContentsId across await so concurrent destroyAll / close-reopen cannot kill the wrong host. New tests cover delayed bootstrap, ack timeout, idempotent ack, and interleaved close race.

DEV-074 review: xmind content.json sheet & rootTopic now preserves fields simple-mind-map does not model (boundaries / relationships / theme / skeleton / topicPositioning) on save; rebuilt-side fields still take precedence.

DEV-074 review: xlsx rels merge now drops rebuilt-side entries when their Id collides with an original relationship and re-adds the original. OpenXML part references must keep their original Id; renaming would silently break vbaProject/chart/externalLink targets.
binary:gitignore:set toggling: preserves user CRLF and surrounding rules; only the marker + .docx/.xlsx/.xmind lines are managed. Enabling also calls git rm --cached on already-tracked binaries.
Editor drop import: dragging a .docx/.xlsx/.xmind from Finder onto the editor or a directory row imports via binary:import. External paths still go through main-process dialogs only.
IPC contract: new 'binary:host:ready' channel with runtime validator and senderId-based dispatch in binary-handlers; binary:gitignore:set response now reports removedFromIndex.
